subject: C40
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:56,225,245,257 and tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c40.py:151: At 900×600 and 200% zoom, the fractional columns collapse while result/action content overlaps them. Both retained layouts-cases-900x600-200 screenshots show overlapping headers, missing case names/input, and action buttons obscuring verdicts. table_usable checks only action size/containment and footer existence, so it incorrectly passes this layout. Fix the responsive table and strengthen the native assertions to check readable case/input/result regions and their separation from actions. Acceptance: both themes remain usable at the required size/zoom, assertions reject the retained bad geometry, and a fresh source-bound native run passes.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:84,198,214,220,367,375: Failure feedback remains behind the inert, aria-hidden page. A rejected save keeps New test case open, but CaseForm receives neither library.problem nor the dispatch error; invalidInput is explicitly suppressed by send. The packs dialog receives notices/export state only, so malformed/foreign-tenant/full-library import problems are likewise inaccessible. Render the relevant problem, failure and unconfirmed outcome inside the active dialog while preserving entered fields. Acceptance: refusal and failed-import component tests assert an accessible explanation within the open dialog, with recovery possible without closing it or losing the draft.

R3 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:276,344,394: Recorded result pills are spans with no activation handler. The frozen R2App prototype:404 makes them buttons opening result details. Runtime rows offer only Open in Playground, while non-Runtime results are discarded by the core; consequently the result-bearing detail sheet is unreachable through normal production data. Make a recorded result keyboard/pointer accessible and open the 520px read-only sheet using available core data, without inventing missing result metadata. Acceptance: after a Playground result is recorded, activating its pill opens the correct verdict/time details, dispatches no scan, and restores focus on close.

R4 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/test-cases.tsx:423,611: Inspect replaces the authored input with payload whenever payload is present, including the default empty JSON object, and never displays response. A newly authored specification with meaningful prompt/response and the untouched '{}' payload therefore opens a sheet showing '{}' instead of its input. This carried-forward C33 defect leaves authored specifications incompletely inspectable. Display input/specification, response and product payload separately. Acceptance: round-trip a non-Runtime case with distinct input, response and payload through the production contract and assert all are readable in Inspect; an empty payload object must not hide the input.
